audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree row for row and match the packet: Aurora 1-3, Skill at 4-5 and 6, Master Yi at first item and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike gives no timers and calls Between Worlds a 'zone wall'.
audit.why: Between Worlds is 140/120/100s — the longest cooldown in the matchup — and it creates a slowing area she can teleport across, not a wall. Highlander is a flat 85s, so you get roughly one and a half ults per one of hers.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now carries both numbers and the real R behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three false mechanics. (a) The content layer calls her W 'Feary Form' and a 'dash-plus-cleanse'. It is Across the Veil: a leap that puts her into the spirit realm invisible with bonus Move Speed — no cleanse. (b) Spirit Abjuration is written as damage that 'chunks you'; it heals Aurora. (c) The full layer repeatedly says she roots you. Nothing in her kit roots — E and R slow, and Highlander is immune to slows.
audit.why: A player waiting out a cleanse, fearing a root that does not exist, and skipping anti-heal loses every extended fight for the wrong reasons.
audit.corrected: W = Across the Veil (22/21/20/19/18s), leap into invisibility. P = Spirit Abjuration, a heal — Grievous Wounds is a real purchase here. E = The Weirding (15/14/13/12/11s), damage, slow, backward hop. Highlander's slow immunity ignores her E slow and the Between Worlds zone slow outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears nowhere despite her passive being a sustained heal off every spell and attack.
audit.why: Extended fights are exactly where Master Yi wins, and her passive is what stretches them.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named in spikes[0].text and late.

edits.before: Aurora pokes and controls the lane with her Q (Twofold Hex) double bolt and W (Feary Form) dash-plus-cleanse, and her passive spirits chunk you on repeated hits. You can't fight into that early, so dodge her Q with sidesteps and farm at range.
edits.after: Aurora pokes with Twofold Hex (Q, 9s) — the recast drags the curse back through you for a second hit — and Across the Veil (W, 22s) leaps her into invisibility, not a cleanse. Spirit Abjuration heals her off every hit, so buy Grievous Wounds and farm at range.

edits.before: Roughly even. Her R (Between Worlds) zone wall is more of a teamfight tool than a duel threat; your Highlander is up, and Q Alpha Strike lets you dash onto her past her W dash to start contesting.
edits.after: Roughly even. Between Worlds (R, 140s at rank 1) slows inside its zone and lets her teleport across it — Highlander's slow immunity ignores that slow entirely, so fight her inside it once your 85s ult is up.

edits.before: You out-scale: Highlander resets and true damage delete a squishy mage when you're on her. Her only outs are W dash and R displacement, so time your Q to follow her escapes and stay locked on.
edits.after: You out-scale: Highlander resets and true damage delete a squishy mage when you're on her. Her outs are the W leap into invisibility (22s) and the R teleport, so hold Alpha Strike to follow, not to open.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 favour Aurora: her Q pokes twice and her passive spirits chunk you while you have no trade tools, so farm carefully at range.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 favour Aurora: her Q hits twice per cast and her passive heals off every hit while you have no trade tools, so farm at range.

edits.before: After your first item you out-DPS and out-scale a squishy Aurora when you stick — Q follows her W dash and Highlander resets close fights before she walls away.
edits.after: After your first item you out-DPS a squishy Aurora when you stick — keep Grievous Wounds up against her passive, and Highlander's slow immunity ignores her R zone.

edits.before: At 2 her passive spirit damage keeps her ahead in exchanges.
edits.after: At 2 her passive heals off every hit, keeping her ahead in trades.

edits.before: Poke with Q bolts and stack passive spirit damage
edits.after: Poke with Q recasts and heal off her passive spirits

edits.before: Use W dash-cleanse and R wall to disengage
edits.after: Use the W leap and R zone to break away

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges her root and burst if timed onto her cast, but it can't be aimed at her from poke range and is wasted if she E-blinks first. Highlander's slow immunity neuters any slow component of her kit, leaving only her hard root to catch you. Meditate's damage reduction blunts her poke but is interrupted if you're rooted mid-channel.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges her burst if timed onto her cast, but it can't be aimed at her from poke range and is wasted if she E-hops first. Highlander's slow immunity cancels her E slow AND the slow inside Between Worlds, so she has nothing left that holds you — she has no root. Meditate's damage reduction blunts her poke, but any CC ends the channel.

edits.before: Track her E blink above all — it is her get-out-of-jail. Count it the moment she uses it to reposition or dodge; the ~window it's down is your only clean all-in. Secondarily track her root, which is what catches you after Alpha Strike.
edits.after: Track The Weirding (E, 15s at rank 1) — it damages, slows and hops her backward, and the window it is down is your only clean all-in. Across the Veil (W, 22s) is her second escape; count both before you commit Highlander.

edits.before: If you blink to her while her root is up she catches you the instant the untargetable frames end and bursts you — bait the root or all-in when it's down.
edits.after: If you blink in while her E is up she slows and hops away the instant the untargetable frames end — bait the E out, then all-in once it is on cooldown.

notes: Aurora has no root anywhere in Riot's current text; the full layer asserted one in several places and the two highest-traffic ones are corrected here. Other full-layer fields (phases[1].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.trading, report[3].t) still say 'root' and should be swept in a later pass. Also, the missing-interactions file claims Between Worlds cancels Meditate; Riot's R text gives it damage, a slow and a crossable zone with no interrupt, and the mirror audit reached the same conclusion, so that claim was NOT written. The W is named 'Feary Form' on the page; the real name is Across the Veil.
